name: Spinal Dural Arteriovenous Fistula
definition: Abnormal arteriovenous shunt in the spinal dura causing venous hypertension and progressive congestive myelopathy, often affecting middle-aged or older adults.

investigations.principle: MRI may show cord edema and perimedullary flow voids; spinal angiography confirms the fistula.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, inflammatory, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Definitive treatment is endovascular embolization or surgical disconnection depending on anatomy.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Vata/myelopathy framework is secondary to vascular diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Abnormal arteriovenous shunt in the spinal dura causing venous hypertension and progressive congestive myelopathy, often affecting middle-aged or older adults.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, sphincter change, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
